items.summary: Identify and fix the root cause(s) of the Version 7 production go-live (publish) failure by performing a full frontend + backend build pass and resolving any compile/build/runtime-blocking errors with minimal, stability-focused changes.

Audit routing/guard/redirect logic to ensure no navigation occurs during render and that redirects are handled in effects (or equivalent safe patterns) to prevent runtime crashes during deployment/first load.

Verify backend authorization/bootstrap-admin logic builds and behaves correctly in a clean deployment so that admin gating does not cause traps/errors during app initialization (e.g., role/profile queries).
